OR (the event occurs when either the specified match or I/O condition occurs)
IO (uses the specified I/O condition only)
AND (the event occurs when the specified match and I/O condition occur simultaneously)
Value of STATEV added to that of STATE (the carry out is ignored)
Value of STATEV loaded into that of STATE
Direction independent (event triggered regardless of the count direction)
Counting up (event triggered only during up-counting when CTRL[BIDIR] = 1)
Counting down (event triggered only during down-counting when CTRL[BIDIR] = 1)
